addr: ground floor, Raheja Arcade, 7th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095, India

rev.t: Harsha is amazing and the ice cream was amazing. Highly recommend having the kaju katli flavour

The ambience was really special. When I walked in, the place felt fresh and welcoming. I tried four flavours: Caramel, Chocolate Nova, French Vanilla, and Biscoff. Out of all four, I liked French Vanilla the most
Unique flavors and tasty ice creams. Highly recommended if you love trying different flavored desserts
